description: Customisable settings for the assistant-panel app

name.description: Name of the application. Appended to browser page titles and used as the fallback location for bookings

title.description: Base browser page title for the application

short_name.description: Short name for the application. Used as the app name for PlaceOS API metadata and page titles

logo.description: Application logo to display on light backgrounds

logo_dark.description: Application logo to display on dark backgrounds

general.description: General settings associated with the app

prevent_space_init.description: Whether to prevent loading the full list of bookable spaces on application startup

chat.description: Settings for the global AI assistant chat widget

enabled.description: Whether to show the global AI assistant chat widget. Defaults to `false`

type.description: Type of icon to render. Either `img` or `icon`

src.description: URL of the image icon to display

class.description: CSS class to apply to icon container element

content.description: Content to add to the icon container element
